from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Record of financial metrics for a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of Total Assets")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Total Assets, e.g., 'millions', 'thousands'")
    
    total_equity_value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of Total Stockholders' Equity or Deficit")
    total_equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Total Equity, e.g., 'millions', 'thousands'")
    
    net_income_value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of Net Income (negative for loss)")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Net Income, e.g., 'millions', 'thousands'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_records: list[CompanyFinancials]
